transcript: Hey, hey, down, down, down. What may we ask were you going to do with a Vex teleporter? Get up close and personal with Gull, put a bullet in his head, then maybe eat a sandwich. Cade, you can't do this alone. Hell, I can't. Even if you manage to kill Gull, when the Red Legion leave a system, they leave nothing behind. The Cabal are bad guys who do bad things. Yes, I get it. I'm sorry, but I do not think you do. They have a weapon that can destroy a star, and it is pointed directly at our sun. Hey, hey, hey, EC, EC. You're going to blow a bulb. Zavala has a plan. He needs you, Cade. Yes, well, Zavala always says he has a plan, but sometimes he just... Wait. Zavala said he needs me? As in you heard those exact words coming out of Zavala's mouth? We did. Please tell me you recorded it. Well, did a Korra at least hear it? Well, did a Korra at least hear it? Well, did a Korra at least hear it?
metadata_caption: CAYDE being CAYDE During the Red War Destiny 2 #shorts
